=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:6788-6790 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Both provider-error extraction paths (Error: line and OpenCode level=ERROR fallback) strip backticks from the extracted error string, but the operator-facing messages embed the result in Markdown code spans without sanitizing the backticks.
  WHY: Provider stderr containing a backtick reaches `${editor_last_error}` unchanged; the PR comment wraps that value in a single-backtick Markdown span, allowing the embedded character to terminate the span prematurely. Severity disagreement: other reviewers verified that the current code now strips backticks, so this finding appears stale.
- tests/test_review_autofix_editor_noop_cascade_contract.py:1103-1146 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The three-attempt fixture contains both a level=ERROR line and a later Error: line, so the primary grep succeeds and the fallback parser is never exercised.
  WHY: The fallback parser for structured OpenCode errors (level=ERROR ... error="...") is untested in isolation, creating a regression risk for the newly documented fallback path. Other reviewers verified that a separate OpenCode-only fixture now exercises the fallback, so this finding appears stale.
- tests/test_review_autofix_editor_noop_cascade_contract.py:1192-1217 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The two new behavioral tests (test_validator_classifies_recoverable_failure_summary and test_noop_warning_step_branches_on_recoverable_failure_with_last_error) are not executed by the direct module runner (__main__).
  WHY: The release gate runs this module directly (mark-stable.yml:341), but pytest-specific fixtures and TemporaryDirectory usage prevent execution under direct invocation, allowing runtime regressions to pass undetected. Other reviewers verified that the __main__ block now invokes both tests, so this finding appears stale.
